target_environment: production VPS /home/ubuntu/mory_assistant and the configured Telegram group
goal: Delete configured meaningless group messages five minutes after an exact keyword match without punishing the sender.

technical_checks.name: local_release_gates
technical_checks.evidence: 1173 unit tests passed in the clean release worktree; focused tests, compileall, DB method registration, config sync, documentation consistency, migration downgrade-upgrade roundtrip and deploy-ready gates passed.

technical_checks.name: remote_version_and_hashes
technical_checks.evidence: Production version is v5.38.62 and raw SHA-256 values for 10 critical files match the clean release worktree byte for byte.

technical_checks.name: database_migration
technical_checks.evidence: Alembic is 0007_keyword_message_auto_delete; all five recovery columns and idx_msg_snapshots_auto_delete exist; PRAGMA integrity_check returned ok.

technical_checks.name: systemd_and_health
technical_checks.evidence: Bot PID 1035200 and Dashboard PID 1028658 are active and enabled with NRestarts=0; health returned HTTP 200; runtime config and database permissions remain 0600.

business_probes.name: real_inbound_exact_match
business_probes.evidence: A real human group message was automatically matched at 2026-08-17 22:21:06 CST and scheduled for 300 seconds without manual dispatcher invocation.

business_probes.name: real_telegram_deletion
business_probes.evidence: The same message was deleted at 2026-08-17 22:26:07 CST; persisted status is deleted with zero failed attempts, and a second Telegram delete returned message_not_found.

business_probes.name: no_punishment_side_effect
business_probes.evidence: blacklist, global_blacklist, mute_records and ad_suspicious_users all contained zero records for the matched user after deletion.

persistence_probe.evidence: A separate real existing matched message remained pending across a Bot restart and was then deleted by keyword_message_auto_delete recovery; Telegram subsequently returned message_not_found.

known_risks: The in-process timer and one-minute recovery task can reach the same due message concurrently; production observed one deleted outcome and one already_gone outcome, both idempotently resolving the same persistent row as deleted.
